title: dCanvas 1.1
description: Dialogue Canvas format v1.1 — a strict superset of JSON Canvas 1.0. The d- prefix is reserved for the dCanvas vocabulary (unknown d- fields are reserved for future format versions); the x- prefix is the conventional home of project extensions. Implementations MUST preserve unrecognised fields on round-trip, recursively, regardless of prefix.

d-version.description: Format version identifier. Major version governs compatibility: this schema describes the 1.1 structure and accepts any 1.x document, which therefore validates exactly when it is structurally compatible.

nodes.description: Canvas nodes in ascending z-index order.

canvasColor.description: Node or edge color. Either a hex color (e.g. "#FF0000") or a preset number ("1"-"6").

side.description: Side of a node where an edge connects.

character.description: Speaker information for a dialogue node. Open object: project-specific keys are allowed and MUST be preserved.

textId.description: String-table reference for name (e.g. "#1001"). The value format is a project convention, not part of the format.

portrait.description: Portrait image filename. Absent or empty means no portrait.

node.description: A canvas node. Only text-type nodes carry dialogue semantics; a text node with d-kind is a dialogue node, otherwise a plain annotation. Unknown fields MUST be preserved.

id.description: Unique node identifier within the file (the canvas id). Referenced by edges.

text.description: Spoken content of the node, as literal text. For a line node, what the character says; for a reply node, what the player says.

subpath.description: Subpath to a heading or block within a file (file-type nodes).

d-id.description: Engine/domain identifier of this node (e.g. "ABELA[5]"). Distinct from the canvas id. The value format is a project convention, not part of the format.

d-kind.description: Closed rendering hint. line = utterance spoken to the player; reply = the player's own utterance.

d-textId.description: String-table reference for text (e.g. "#2687"). The value format is a project convention, not part of the format.

d-action.description: Engine action executed when this node is reached.

d-sound.description: Sound resource for this node's spoken line.

d-alternativeCharacters.description: Other characters who may speak the line. Exactly one of d-character and these speaks it; their order carries no meaning. Allowed only together with d-character.

edge.description: A connection between two nodes. Unknown fields MUST be preserved.

id.description: Unique edge identifier within the file.

fromSide.description: Side of the source node where the edge starts.

fromEnd.description: Endpoint shape at edge start. Defaults to "none".

toSide.description: Side of the destination node where the edge ends.

toEnd.description: Endpoint shape at edge end. Defaults to "arrow".

label.description: Player-facing choice text — what the player sees and picks, as literal text.

d-id.description: Engine/domain identifier of this edge. The value format is a project convention, not part of the format.

d-kind.description: Closed rendering hint. loop marks a back-edge (a cycle); normal a forward transition.

d-condition.description: Engine condition expression that gates this transition.

d-textId.description: String-table reference for label, when present. The value format is a project convention, not part of the format.
